patches.name: memory-search-half-life
patches.note: Memory search temporal-decay half-life 365 days instead of the hard-coded 30 (see DOCS.md, "Memory search recency").

patches.name: telegram-voice-text-first
patches.note: Telegram hotfix VOLT-TG-20261023 (1/3): a single voice reply whose text exceeds the caption limit sends and confirms the text first, then the audio without caption; a network failure or voice-privacy rejection of the audio keeps the text and is not retried.

patches.name: telegram-delivery-live-custody
patches.note: Telegram hotfix VOLT-TG-20261023 (2/3): a process-local refcount per sessionId/intentId is held from the start of a direct reply delivery until its canonical settlement (also across deferred finalization).

patches.name: telegram-notice-live-guard
patches.note: Telegram hotfix VOLT-TG-20261023 (2/3): the pending-delivery notice ("I couldn’t confirm whether my previous reply reached this chat ...") skips an intent that is still being delivered; settled unknown outcomes and restart debts are still reported.

patches.name: telegram-fetch-fresh-audio
patches.note: Telegram hotfix VOLT-TG-20261023 (3/3): sendVoice/sendAudio use a fresh connection and the strict safe-to-retry check like sendMessage, so an upload that Telegram may have accepted is not replayed.
